errors.text: The proposed Mo addition does not reconstruct the target intervention of spark plasma sintering the MgAlTiVFeCo alloy at 1000 °C.
No Mo concentration or base-alloy composition is specified, so the intervention is neither reproducible nor demonstrably compatible with the required density below 6 g/cm3.

The cited evidence does not concern previously reported Mg-containing lightweight high-entropy alloys: E1 concerns a Zr-containing Al-Nb-Ti-V alloy, E2 concerns FeCoCrNi-based coatings, and E3 concerns Nb variation in an Al-Ti-Zr-Nb-Mo alloy.
The hypothesis omits the key processing and testing boundaries: 800–1000 °C sintering, the upper limit imposed by Mg volatilization, oxidation at 900 °C in air, and defined exposure times.
The proposed mechanism is unsupported for the stated Mg alloy and conflicts with the target mechanism involving densification and uniformly distributed oxide barrier phases.
No quantitative predictions are supplied for density, hardness or compression, oxidation kinetics, or electrochemical behavior.
